headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty hit eight-month highs as Nifty reclaimed the 25,000 level

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: Strong performance in banking and pharmaceutical stocks led the market gains
A correction in global oil prices supported investor sentiment
Nifty reclaimed the 25,000 level after recovering from a dip during the Muhurat session
PSU bank stocks saw significant buying interest to lead the rally
whatHappening: L&T secured a major order worth up to ₹2,500 crore for the Noida Metro Aqua Line extension
Data Patterns shares surged 9% during the previous trading session
Sensex surpassed the 81,000 mark to close at its highest level in over eight months
The market is currently closed for an NSE holiday and will resume trading on Wednesday
summary: In the last session, Indian indices closed at multi-month highs as Nifty reclaimed 25,000 and Sensex crossed 81,000. Gains were driven by banking and pharma sectors, while L&T announced a major metro rail order win. The market is closed today for an NSE holiday and will resume trading on Wednesday.
